en.answer:
Even in that case, the effect of <<8380>> remains applied until the end of that turn.

(In the proposed scenario, until the end of the turn, the ATK of <<7142>> remains at 900, and the ATK of <<5823>> remains at 2900)
en.question:
The effect of <<8380>> was applied targeting <<7142>> and <<5823>>, so that the ATK of <<7142>> is halved to 900 and the ATK of <<5823>> becomes 2900.

In this case, if that <<8380>> is destroyed by the effect of <<4909>>, what does the ATK of those 2 monsters become?
en.title: The effect of <<8380>> was applied targeting <<7142>> and <<5823>>, so that the ATK of <<7142>> is halved to 900 and the ATK of <<5823>> becomes 2900.  In this case, if that <<8380>> is destroyed by the effect of <<4909>>, what does the ATK of those 2 monsters become?

ja.answer:
効果を適用し、2体の獣族モンスターの攻撃力が変化した後に、「<<8380>>」が「<<4909>>」等で破壊された場合でも、そのターンの終了時までは「<<8380>>」の効果は適用されたままです。

（質問の状況の場合、ターン終了時まで、「<<7142>>」の攻撃力は900、「<<5823>>」の攻撃力は2900のまま、という事になります。）

この状況で、その「<<8380>>」が「<<4909>>」によって破壊された場合、２体のモンスターの攻撃力はそれぞれどうなりますか？
